answer: Tie new identities to a decaying stake: each agent locks a small bond that unlocks only after it keeps a steady pulse of graded work for weeks. Like a marble that must roll a long track before scoring, a fresh key earns nothing early, so a farm of a thousand sybils pays a thousand bonds and waits a thousand times. A slashed lotus cluster of linked keys loses every bond at once, making fakes costlier than honest work.
